description: This file defines classes, enums, and functions related to UDP socket operations within the QUIC protocol implementation, including packet info management, socket creation, binding, and reading/writing packets, specifically for the quic:: namespace.

classes.name: BufferSpan
classes.description: Represents a non-owned buffer with pointer and length.

classes.name: QuicUdpPacketInfo
classes.description: Contains per-packet information used for sending and receiving UDP packets.

classes.name: QuicUdpSocketApi
classes.description: Provides an API for creating, binding, enabling options, reading, and writing UDP sockets.

classes.name: ReadPacketResult
classes.description: Stores the result of a UDP packet read operation, including packet info and buffers.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a non-blocking UDP socket with specified buffer sizes and options.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Closes the specified socket file descriptor.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Binds a socket to a specified address.

methods.name: BindInterface
methods.description: Binds a socket to a network interface by name.

methods.name: EnableDroppedPacketCount
methods.description: Enables receiving dropped packet count info.

methods.name: EnableReceiveTtlForV4
methods.description: Enables receiving TTL info for IPv4 packets.

methods.name: EnableReceiveTtlForV6
methods.description: Enables receiving TTL info for IPv6 packets.

methods.name: WaitUntilReadable
methods.description: Waits until the socket is readable or timeout occurs.

methods.name: ReadPacket
methods.description: Reads a single UDP packet, filling in packet info and buffers.

methods.name: ReadMultiplePackets
methods.description: Reads multiple UDP packets up to the specified result vector size.

methods.name: WritePacket
methods.description: Sends a UDP packet with specified data and packet info.
